info.title: Hell Teacher Nube
info.synopsis: Meisuke Nueno, chiamato anche Nube, insegna nella scuola elementare della città di Domori. In verità in Nube si nasconde l'identità di un esorcista il cui compito è difendere la città dai numerosi eventi soprannaturali che incombono quotidianamente. Egli è in grado di far fronte a tali minacce grazie al potere donatogli dal demone rinchiuso nella sua mano sinistra. In tutto ciò però Nube non sarà solo, ma circondato dai suoi studenti che lo aiuteranno a riportare la città alla normalità... o a metterla in pericolo?!

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: A new school term begins; Hiroshi's heart is attacked by a Yōkai, so Nube must save his life.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Nube, Kyoko and Hiroshi investigate a ghost that appears in the bathroom.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: A talkative youkai makes everybody hate Miki because of her harsh rumors.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: A Kappa tries to stop the horizontal bars being used because there's a bomb.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: Katsuya meets a troubled boy who makes him cross the 13th step.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: A Kitsune, Yoko Tamamo, tries to kill Hiroshi to get his skull and become human. On Nube's attempt to save Hiroshi, Nube ended topless in a blood bath after he falls in a dark warehouse and his torso, arms, and back are slashed by 4 claws.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: Nube fights Yoko Tamamo to save Hiroshi, despite his injury and blood loss. If Nube attempted to save Hiroshi, it is Hiroshi who will save and takes care of Nube with loving hug as the latter suffers in injury and blood loss.

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: Shuichi meets Hiroshi, Kyoko, Miki and Katsuya to witness a UFO.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: Miki gains the ability to stretch her neck and spy on her friends.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: Akira is constantly attacked by a demon who ruins his works.

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: Nube and Yukime meet again after a long time; she tries to freeze him and take him with her to the mountains.

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: After a picnic, the school bus is attacked by a youkai.

episodes.title: Episodio 13
episodes.synopsis: Katsuya steals money from a shrine, now the sword from that temple turns into a youkai trying to kill sinful people, including Katsuya.

episodes.title: Episodio 14
episodes.synopsis: Kyoko's doppelganger flees and Nube must find it before Kyoko dies.

episodes.title: Episodio 15
episodes.synopsis: Yukime returns, but this time, with plans of live as a human, causing problems to Nube, and risking her life at the end trying to save the life of a girl trapped in a fire.

episodes.title: Episodio 16
episodes.synopsis: In an attempt to save Makoto, Nube ends up possessed by a powerful youkai making impossible for him to use his Oni no te.

episodes.title: Episodio 17
episodes.synopsis: Kyoko gets swimming lessons from the pool ghost.

episodes.title: Episodio 18
episodes.synopsis: A giant fish youkai attacks the school and Nube and Youko Tamamo allies to defeat it.

episodes.title: Episodio 19
episodes.synopsis: Nube and Yukime pursuit a demon who is killing the love pairs in Doumori.

episodes.title: Episodio 20
episodes.synopsis: Nube travels into the past trying to prevent Minako-sensei's death.

episodes.title: Episodio 21
episodes.synopsis: After Katsuya accidentally kills a fish from God's lake, God's messenger tries to kill him as a punishment.

episodes.title: Episodio 22
episodes.synopsis: Portions of a ghost appear in the photos of a trip of the 5-3 students.

episodes.title: Episodio 23
episodes.synopsis: Kyoko and Miki reflect themselves on an opposing mirrors on the school at midnight showing them olders, now each time they reflect themselves they see each time more and more older.

episodes.title: Episodio 24
episodes.synopsis: Miki use the love crow legend for spend all her time with Hiroshi, causing Kyoko to get jealous.

episodes.title: Episodio 25
episodes.synopsis: Non abbiamo una descrizione tradotta in inglese. Aiutaci ad espandere il nostro database aggiungendone una.

episodes.title: Episodio 26
episodes.synopsis: Yukime creates a baby that looks like her and Nube and they must stop Yukibe from wreaking havoc in the city.

episodes.title: Episodio 27
episodes.synopsis: Izuna has kudakitsunes that can perform almost anything. One day, an evil one is born and she needs Nube's help to stop it.

episodes.title: Episodio 28
episodes.synopsis: Miki finds a Kesalan Patharan and decides to breed them for her own use. While at the mall, she must decide whether to use them all to save Nube, Kyoko, Hiroshi, and Makoto from falling to their death.

episodes.title: Episodio 29
episodes.synopsis: Nube's class creates a haunted house for a school festival, but it gets scorned by a young gang group who always love to cause a lot of trouble to Domori's populace. Nube then decides to bring in the real spirits for their enjoyment.

episodes.title: Episodio 30
episodes.synopsis: Makoto begins to be pursued by the Ninomia Kinjirou statue after he accidentally rips an ancient book.

episodes.title: Episodio 31
episodes.synopsis: Ai Shinozaki, a great violinist at Doumori begins to have eyeballs appearing on her body because she steals. She must decide to confess or be overtaken by the demon.

episodes.title: Episodio 32
episodes.synopsis: A girl's spirit begins attacking the students of 5-3 because of a missing book that used to be her favorite.

episodes.title: Episodio 33
episodes.synopsis: Mamoru Kazama, a student of Ritsuko sensei's class is sent to the hospital after he sees a dancing demon on top of his house. Ritsuko sensei feels she must protect him and stays with him in the face of danger.

episodes.title: Episodio 34
episodes.synopsis: One day, Nube's demon hand begins to overtake his body and Tamamo, Hiroshi, and Kyoko must travel to the past to find the solution before Nube becomes an Oni.

episodes.title: Episodio 35
episodes.synopsis: Miki realizes one day that buildings are being moved after she says where she wants them. No one else notices because they are already "accustomed" to the new arrangement. She ends up wishing Domori Elementary away and it's up to her to save the school.

episodes.title: Episodio 36
episodes.synopsis: Kyoko bets with Miki that she will learn to play the piano in one week. Kyoko ends up going to secret midnight lessons thinking it's a dream. Her weariness begins to show and it concerns Miki and Nube.

episodes.title: Episodio 37
episodes.synopsis: Makoto stumbles upon a 20-year-old agenda once owned by a student who forgot everything. The student ends up drowning and the spirit comes back to help Makoto. Shortly, the spirit begins to try to kill Makoto and have him discover his body.

episodes.title: Episodio 38
episodes.synopsis: Yukime upsets Zashiki Warashi, so the Zashiki Warashi brings good luck to Nube by having Ritsuko sensei ask Nube on a date and making Yukime jealous.

episodes.title: Episodio 39
episodes.synopsis: Shuichi's turtle that went down the drain comes back as a monster that Tamamo thinks will be satisfied if Shuichi is sacrificed.

episodes.title: Episodio 40
episodes.synopsis: Izuna begins to spontaneously burst into fire at random times. She must relieve her stress that has built up or else she will perish.

episodes.title: Episodio 41
episodes.synopsis: A model of the human body in a science class inherits a spirit and doesn't realize that he isn't an human being. He wants to become friends with Nube's classmates, but they are terrified of him.

episodes.title: Episodio 42
episodes.synopsis: Hiroshi's mother is reincarnated as a 4-year-old school girl to see him, but Hiroshi doesn't believe it. She was reincarnated for Hiroshi to know the situation before she died.

episodes.title: Episodio 43
episodes.synopsis: Yukime is fooled into thinking that taking a human's soul will turn her into a human. Yukime targets Ritsuko sensei because Yukime wants to have a relationship with Nube.

episodes.title: Episodio 44
episodes.synopsis: A demon takes on the form of Nube and orders every student in the class to tell their scariest stories to aid in opening the portal to the spirit world.

episodes.title: Episodio 45
episodes.synopsis: Non abbiamo una descrizione tradotta in inglese. Aiutaci ad espandere il nostro database aggiungendone una.

episodes.title: Episodio 46
episodes.synopsis: Non abbiamo una descrizione tradotta in inglese. Aiutaci ad espandere il nostro database aggiungendone una.

episodes.title: Episodio 47
episodes.synopsis: The God of Poverty targets Nube and makes his money vanish so he becomes poor. What both of them don't realize is that everyone that knows Nube loves and cares for him.

episodes.title: Episodio 48
episodes.synopsis: Kyoko wakes up one day just to discover that she already becomes a mature woman and her life becomes entirely different than how it should be.

episodes.title: Episodio 49
episodes.synopsis: A collection/recap of all the episodes(an encyclopedia of demons, spirits, the story of the Oni no te, the romances, etc.)

related.title: Jigoku Sensei Nube (Movie)
related.plot: Kumiko Ijima, una delle studentesse di Nube, riconosce un uomo in un parco locale come un criminale ricercato per omicidio quando si ricorda di aver disegnato il suo volto a partire dalle foto segnaletiche affisse dalla polizia. Kumiko avverte la sua compagna di classe Kyoko, ma nel frattempo l’uomo scopre il disegno con le iniziali "K.I." scritto sul portfolio di Kumiko e nota brevemente che la ragazza indossa un nastro rosso tra i capelli. I poliziotti inseguono il criminale, che finisce per schiantarsi contro un sigillo, liberando un demone che prende possesso della sua anima. Il demone inizia così una strage, cercando qualsiasi ragazza che indossi un nastro rosso e le cui iniziali siano "K.I.".

related.title: Jigoku Sensei Nube: Gozen 0 Ji Nube Shisu!
related.plot: Un nuovo studente arriva nella classe di Nube. Si chiama Jun ed è un ragazzo solitario che ama moltissimo i clown. Il suo unico amico è Pierre, un clown che vive nello specchio. Una notte, Pierre regala a Jun una maschera dai poteri misteriosi. Da quel momento, Jun inizia a comportarsi in modo strano e molti incidenti cominciano ad accadere nella scuola.

related.title: Jigoku Sensei Nube: Kyoufu no Natsuyasumi!! Ayashi no Umi no Densetsu!
related.plot: Quando Nube e la sua classe arrivano su una piccola isola per svolgere attività sulla spiaggia, sentono un racconto inquietante da un vecchio che vive sull’isola. La leggenda narra che, nei mari aperti intorno all’isola, esiste una creatura conosciuta come il ragno marino. Quando questa creatura supera i 200 anni, si trasforma in un mostro e divora esseri umani per placare il suo appetito. Tuttavia, la curiosità è pericolosa e Yukime decide di indagare sulla veridicità della leggenda. Improvvisamente, una ragazza appare sulla spiaggia. Possedendo uno strano fascino, attira subito l’attenzione di Hiroshi e riesce a sedurlo. Poco dopo, iniziano ad accadere eventi strani: Kyoko e la professoressa Ritsuko vengono attaccate in circostanze misteriose. L’identità della ragazza misteriosa viene messa in discussione e la leggenda della creatura marina sembra essere vera dopotutto.
